🇦🇹 Vienna Series - Das Schöneberg Vienna’s third district. A 15-minute walk from Belvedere Palace, but a world away from the crowds there. They’re known for their cheese toasties. I somehow missed them this trip, which just means I have a reason to come back. What I did notice was everything else: the home-baked goods lined up under glass, tiny coffee plants growing on a shelf above the counter, and a wall by the bathroom covered in old photos and community flyers. The kind of small details that tell you people actually care about this place. There’s cosy seating inside and a lovely terrace outside, my personal favourite when the weather allows it.
